positions.name: KestrelwoodCalibration
positions.frame: how is the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration established and verified?
positions.why: src-1 asserts the calibration at 88.4 MHz, src-2 verifies it against June reference plates across the full observing band, and src-3 records these as key session decisions — all three cohere under the question of how the calibration was established and confirmed. src-3 carries a declarative footing (session as principal) that recaps the same event src-1 and src-2 witness assertively; the tension between first-hand assertion and decision-record recap is held, not resolved.
